summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the grant of 139,120 restricted share units (RSUs) to 37 employees under its 2021 Plan. The RSUs convert into Class B ordinary shares at no purchase price; vesting occurs in four equal annual installments with no performance targets. The board and compensation committee approved the grants as fair and reasonable. This is an ordinary equity compensation disclosure, not a special situation. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or any event altering the company's control or capital structure. The filing is routine and requires no further action or risk-arbitrage analysis.
